meta.name: paid-ads-tiktok
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, and safely operate connected TikTok Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for TikTok advertising, Spark Ads, short-form video ads, campaign or ad-group analysis, spend, conversions, targeting, creative, budgets, bids, creator briefs, campaign setup, or approved TikTok Ads changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并调整 TikTok 广告投放,管好预算、出价与素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在跑 TikTok 广告,想查花费、转化和出价哪里不对
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and adjust TikTok ad campaigns, tuning budgets, bids, and creative
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run TikTok ads and want to see where spend, conversions, and bids went wrong

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 NotFair MCP 连上你的 TikTok Ads 账户,读取实时投放数据做审计和诊断;经你批准后安全改动作,流程是预览、应用一次、再回读确认结果。
howto.when: 当你要看或改 TikTok 广告时接管,例如广告系列或广告组表现、花费与转化、预算与出价等;连接缺失或未授权时,它会先让你重新授权并停下。

say.text: 查一下这个 TikTok 广告账户近 7 天的花费和转化
say.note: 读取实时数据并给出诊断

say.text: 把这个广告组的日预算从 50 调到 80,先给我预览
say.note: 展示改动后等你批准再应用

say.text: 帮我写一条 Spark Ads 前 3 秒的创意脚本
say.note: 产出含钩子与 CTA 的创意简报

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to your TikTok Ads account through the NotFair MCP to read live delivery data, audit and diagnose campaigns, and — after your approval — apply changes: preview, apply once, then read back.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about TikTok advertising — spend, conversions, budgets and bids, etc. If the connector is missing or unauthorized, it asks you to re-authorize first.

say_en.text: Check this TikTok Ads account's spend and conversions for the last 7 days
say_en.note: Reads live data and gives a diagnosis

say_en.text: Raise this ad group's daily budget from 50 to 80 — preview it first
say_en.note: Shows the change, then waits for your approval

say_en.text: Write a Spark Ads script with a first-3-second hook
say_en.note: Produces a creative brief with hook and CTA
